title: Decoupling Perception from Description: Computation-Grounded Representation Alignment between Multivariate Time Series and Language
abstract: arXiv:2608.05238v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Training multimodal models to align time series with language runs into a self-supervision trap. The usual recipe asks an LLM to read a series and write a description, so label quality is capped by the perceptual skill the model is supposed to learn. The data can never teach more than the labeler already knows. A second gap makes this worse: most datasets use a single variable, but the patterns that matter (cross-channel correlation, lead-lag structure, co-occurring anomalies) appear only with several variables, right where the labeling LLM's limits are most exposed. These two problems create a trilemma: existing methods are reliable, realistic, or scalable, but none achieves all three. We resolve this by decoupling perception from description. translated_title: 解耦感知与描述：基于计算的多变量时间序列与语言之间的表征对齐
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.05238v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：训练多模态模型以将时间序列与语言对齐时会陷入自监督陷阱。通常的做法是让大语言模型（LLM）读取一个时间序列并撰写描述，因此标签质量受限于模型本应学会的感知能力——数据所能教给模型的永远不会超过标注者已经掌握的知识。第二个差距使问题更加严重：大多数数据集只使用单一变量，而真正重要的模式（跨通道相关性、领先-滞后结构、共现异常）只有在多个变量下才会出现，而这恰恰是标注 LLM 的能力局限最暴露无遗的地方。这两个问题构成了一个三难困境：现有方法要么可靠、要么真实、要么可扩展，但没有一种能同时实现这三点。我们通过将感知与描述解耦来解决这一问题：确定性代码从真实的开源多变量时间序列中计算出一组统计量，LLM 则将这些预先计算好的事实转化为语言表述。LLM 不擅长的感知任务由计算来处理……
tldr: 该论文提出将感知与描述解耦的范式——由确定性代码从真实开源多变量时间序列中计算统计量，再由LLM将这些预计算事实转化为语言描述，从而突破自监督标注的质量瓶颈，同时实现可靠、真实、可扩展的时间序列-语言对齐。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes decoupling perception from description—deterministic code computes statistics from real open-source multivariate time series while the LLM verbalizes these precomputed facts—breaking the self-supervision labeling quality bottleneck and achieving reliable, realistic, and scalable time series-language alignment.
